title: Installer pocket docket — on-prem / VPC (solo)
content:
Morning sprint notes (solo day) — keep short.

Context:
- Customer: NovaHealth (PHI environment), US-East colo.
- Deployment: Private (VPC) single-rack appliance + optional on-prem GPU node.
- Goal today: complete base install, verify network egress rules, register KMS, run smoke tests.

Top-of-head checklist (quick):
- [ ] Confirm serial numbers & rack ids (tags on side) — Rack 3, U18-22
- [x] Power/copper checked — power A/B healthy as of 08:40
- [ ] BIOS: set power profile -> Performance, disable C-states if recommended
- [x] IPs: assigned from ops DHCP pool (static reservations requested)
- [ ] Confirm MTU - customer uses jumbo frames (9000) across VPN path
- [ ] Firewall rules: need outbound 443 (whitelist Redwood control plane IPs), SNAT ok
- [ ] KMS/HSM: get customer KMS ARN + policy; HSM not reachable yet (ticket open)
- [ ] NTP: point to corp-ntp-1.novah.local (avoid public NTP)
- [ ] DNS: add short entry redwood-private.novah -> appliance mgmt IP
- [ ] SSH bastion confirm (customer uses jumpbox)

Immediate blockers / watchouts:
- Customer network team only allows egress to whitelisted IPs — control-plane ping fails until they whitelist 3 IPs (see JIRA PD-3245). Need SOC/NetSec approval form signed.
- HSM in maintenance window until 15:00 PDT. Can proceed with install but keywrap tests will fail until HSM up.
- Packet capture observed TCP MSS clamping in firewall (likely PMTU/diff) — will need to test with iperf and small MTU fallback.

Quick debug commands (save these):
- Check routes: ip route show && ip -6 route show
- NIC: ethtool -k eth0; ethtool -S eth0 (look for dropped packets)
- MTU test: ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1500; ping -M do -s 8972 <peer>
- Docker verify: docker ps -a | grep redwood && docker logs <container> --tail 200
- K8s smoke: kubectl get nodes && kubectl get pods -A | grep CrashLoopBackOff

Config snippets I keep forgetting to add to runbook:
- sysctl settings: net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1 (temporary until firewall updated)
- ulimit: file descriptors 65536 for redwood user

Smoke test plan (minimal):
1) Control plane handshake: curl -I https://control.redwood.example/health (expect 200, but blocked by IP whitelist)
2) Local inference start: docker-compose up -d sparrow-runtime (watch logs for model loaded event)
3) Tokenization test: echo '{"input":"hello"}' | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/tokenize -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @-
4) Load small model: run ./bin/load_model --model small --quant=4bit ; expect "model ready" within 90s
5) KV cache smoke: invoke sample chat session (2 msgs) and check latency < 120ms local

Notes to self / gotchas:
- If control plane blocked, use local eval harness on USB key (./local-run.sh) so customer can validate on-prem only path.
- Watch for hostnames in cert SANs — customers often require internal CN. Keep openssl commands handy.
- Remember to toggle swap off for GPU nodes (sudo swapoff -a) — otherwise CUDA memory erratic.
- For NIC driver mismatch, check lspci | grep Mellanox and confirm firmware matches vendor doc.

Conversation snippets to paste into ticket later:
- "NetSec confirmed outbound to 3 control-plane IPs OK, pending SOC approval; HSM maintenance end EOD 03/12."
- "Observed MSS clamp on edge firewall; suggest temporary tcp_mtu_probing=1 until PMTU fixed."

Next steps (today):
- 09:30 call with NetSec (Priya) to get whitelist approval (PRIORITY)
- 10:15 attempt local load of small model offline with usb fallback
- 11:00 escalate HSM status with customer (Matt owning)
- 13:00 run full smoke test if whitelist done

Personal reminders (quick):
- Bring spare cat6A and QSFP+ loopback on site kit
- Log everything in PD-3245 (timestamps) — customer requires timeline for audit
- Leave a short handoff note for evening shift (if not closed): what failed, tickets opened, next owner

This doc is a living pocket docket. Short, messy, and pragmatic. Add anything that saves time next time I'm solo on a VPC/onprem install.

Timestamped quick log:
- 2026-03-12 08:40 - Rack powered, OS installed from image v2.7.1
- 2026-03-12 09:05 - DHCP reservations confirmed (ops ticket OP-889)
- 2026-03-12 09:22 - Control-plane ping failed -> opened PD-3245 (NetSec whitelist)
- 2026-03-12 09:45 - Started local model load (usb fallback), partial success (model loaded but tokenization errors)
- 2026-03-12 10:05 - Set tcp_mtu_probing=1; observed improved connectivity to control IPs (intermittent)

End of pocket docket entry.

-- Alex K.
